summary: The density squeeze is a generic fact about a finite pairwise-disjoint family of prime sets whose union has density 1; only its two-line Frobenius specialisations are Chebotarev-specific. The generic core (and its two private helpers, one of which is pure arithmetic with every field instance omitted) belongs in the Dirichlet-density calculus file, not in a Chebotarev module.
